facts.value: Students who choose the BSc in Cyber Security and IT Forensics will come from a variety of backgrounds.

The BSc in Cyber Security and IT Forensics Degree in UL is about teaching you how to build secure systems to protect vital information, like bank details and medical records. You will be equipped with the expertise to be a leader in the on-going mobile networking revolution.
